descriptionText:
National Grid is hiring an Associate Technology Engineer in its Graduate Development Program to help design, configure, test, and improve employee technology. The role supports endpoint management across Windows, macOS, and iOS, including device security, application delivery, automation, and digital employee experience.
Responsibilities
Support the design, configuration, testing, and implementation of endpoint solutions across Windows, macOS, and iOS environments
Help manage device enrollment, provisioning, configuration, application deployment, patching, compliance, security, and operating system lifecycle activities
Use tools such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, and Nexthink to support device health, endpoint management, analytics, and the digital employee experience
Develop and maintain scripts, configuration standards, test plans, implementation procedures, and technical documentation
Investigate technical issues, review device logs and configuration data, and work with experienced engineers and operational teams to identify lasting solutions
Follow version control, cybersecurity, change management, architecture, testing, and engineering assurance practices throughout the technology lifecycle
Skills
Bachelor or Master's degree Computer Science, Computer Networks, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution
Graduated between May 2026 and June 2027
Ability to begin the National Grid Graduate Program on June 7, 2027, or July 12, 2027
Work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States (such as sponsorship for an H-1B, TN, O, L, STEM OPT, or other employment-based work authorization)
Foundational knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or iOS, endpoint management, device provisioning, application deployment, patching, security, and compliance
Exposure to scripting or automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, or a similar technology, along with strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills
Experience with Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Nexthink, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, application packaging, device compliance, or endpoint security
Familiarity with Git, APIs, endpoint analytics, Agile ways of working, or digital employee experience tools
An entry-level certification or active study toward one, such as Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, or an Apple certification
Benefits
Structured development opportunities, mentorship, and ongoing feedback to accelerate your career growth
Exposure to leaders, cross-functional teams, and diverse areas of the business
Opportunities to build your professional network and develop lasting industry connections
Meaningful work and real-world experience that provide a strong foundation for a long-term career at National Grid
A comprehensive benefits package
Up to $6,000 in student loan repayment assistance
Tuition reimbursement benefits of up to $8,000 annually for undergraduate studies and $10,000 annually for graduate studies
Guidance from experienced engineers while building practical engineering and problem-solving skills
Company Overview
National Grid facilitates electricity and gas transmission system and focuses on delivering clean energy. It was founded in 1990, and is headquartered in London, England, GBR, with a workforce of 10001+ employees. Its website is https://www.nationalgrid.com.
